summary: Frontend-only verification of TL dropdown fix in Admin Users Edit Role modal and Files Dashboard visibility. All 3 review scenarios PASSED. TL dropdown now correctly populates with 'Yarragonda Anusha' when Manager 'Saikiran' is selected, and selection persists. Admin sees 514 total files with the file list rendered below stats on /admin/files. GP Nithin (banothunithinnaik@gmail.com) logs in successfully and sees '15 data assigned to you' with all 15 file rows on the agent dashboard.

issues: React hydration errors in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<tr>/<tfoot>/<table>' and 'Cannot infer the option value of complex children'. Caused by ve-dynamic <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers injected around <option>, <tr>, <tfoot>, <tbody>, <table> children. Non-blocking (functionality works) but pollutes console and may cause hydration mismatches. Investigate the dev instrumentation adding these spans.

action_items: Investigate React hydration console warnings from x-ve-dynamic span wrappers around option/tr/table children — likely a dev-tooling/instrumentation issue, but should be scoped out of production bundle.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.js is 1307 lines — split into smaller modules (EditRoleModal, AddUserModal, UsersTable).
TL dropdown useEffect fix (adding showEditRoleModal to deps) is correct and prevents state race on initial mount.
Consider adding data-testid to Edit Role pencil button, Manager select, and Team Lead select in Users.js modal to improve testability (currently only title attributes exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: TL dropdown flow verified end-to-end: Admin -> Users -> search 'Nithin' -> click 'Edit role & hierarchy' pencil -> select Manager 'Saikiran' -> Team Lead dropdown auto-populates with 'Yarragonda Anusha' (id 69b2490466de144b08f2d108). Manager id: 6a9858b55c918623d6764602. Files count = 514 on /admin/files (Team Dashboard) with file distribution chart, loans by type, and files table rendered. GP Nithin login lands on /agent showing '15 data assigned to you'.
rca of the issue: Previous bug (TL dropdown not populating) was caused by useEffect depending only on roleEditData.manager_id, which fired during initial mount and race-condition-overwrote teamLeads state. Fix adds showEditRoleModal to the dependency array and gates the fetch behind modal-open state, and defensively filters options with null ids. Verified working.
